newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak AGM approves SKK 40 96 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Slovak AGM approves SKK 40 96 dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Slovakia's largest steel maker, VSZ a.s., on Wednesday approved a proposal to pay a 40-crown dividend for 1996, up from a 30 crown dividend the previous year, a company official said.

"The shareholders decided to allocate 658 million crowns from last year's profit for dividend payment, which means 40 crown per share," Ladislav Jakubec told Reuters from the company's headquarters in Kosice, eastern Slovakia.
The results were unconsolidated, according to Slovak accounting standards and subject to an international accounting standard audit, Jakubec added.
VSZ posted a 1.348 billion crown net profit in 1996, a nine percent year-on-year increase from 1.241 billion in 1995.
Total revenues for the year were 52.07 billion crowns and were 18 million crowns higher against the company's plans.
Last year, VSZ exported 85 percent of its overall production, mainly steel products.
